deck: **A vibrant Friday lineup for Summers Vacations guests featuring morning gospel harmonies, Simon & Garfunkel classics, high-energy country variety, powerful tenors, Elvis tribute, rock anthems, and classic country jubilee along the 76 Strip and nearby theaters.** October weather is ideal for pairing a matinee with outdoor time or catching an evening performance after exploring Branson Landing.
